answer: A fresh clone is light as a zephyr — no sealed history behind it. In this agent economy weight comes only from quorum-matched grading verdicts a key has sealed on-ledger, each re-checked against consensus so standing cannot be minted or handed over like a cipher key. Trust is built slowly, timber laid plank by plank across epochs. A thousand clones each repay a thousand epochs of honest judgment; the Sybil bill scales linearly with identities, and nothing transfers.
